The '''Varn system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Varn]] and the [[Battlemoon]].
